games.name: Subterra ⛏️ [BETA]
games.desc:
Welcome to Subterra ⛏️! 
It's a 2.5 dimensional mining game with a procedurally generated world where you dig deeper, upgrade your pickaxe and survive layers that get more hostile the further you descend.

❓ [ How to Play ]
- Mine ores and upgrade your pickaxe to go even deeper.
- Build your character with Ability Cards.
- Craft Weapons that help you defeat monsters.
- Obtain rare recipes of weapons and potions.
- Explore various layers.
- Defeat Monsters and Bosses!

💻 [ Controls ]
- E to open Inventory
- C to Interact
- F to Block/Parry
- Left Mouse to Mine

💾 [BETA] 
The game is still under development, expect various changes. 
If you find bugs or have suggestions let us know in the community server!

Thank you for playing!

games.name: Shinobi Reborn
games.desc:
A new era of ninjas has begun. Train, fight, and awaken your true power in a world inspired by Naruto Shippuden.

- Explore vast villages and hidden lands
- Unlock powerful clans and unique Kekkei Genkai
- Engage in PVP and PVE to unlock greater abilities and become stronger.

CONTROLS (💻) 
W + W = Sprint
Q = Dash
F = Block
R = Substitute
E = Throwable
V = Carry
B = Execute
G = Activate Clan Mode
H = Activate Sub Mode
C = Clan Mode (Spec 1)
F + C = Clan Mode (Spec 2)
Z = Sub Mode (Spec 1)
F + Z = Sub Mode (Spec 2)
M = Menu
` = Inventory

CONTROLS (🎮)
X- Attack
B- Dash
Y- Sub
LT - Block
Left Stick - Sprint
RT + X - Weapon
Hold LT + RT + press LS - Shiftlock
Dpad down - Grip
LT + Dpad Left - Clan Mode 
LB + Dpad Left - Clan Spec 1
RT + Dpad Left - Sub Mode 
RB + Dpad Left - Sub Mode Spec 1
LB + RB - Skill Selection
RB - Skill Scroll Left
LB - Skill Scroll Right
RT - execute skills when selected

Starter Code:
WELCOME

Tags:
Naruto, Shippuden, Uchiha, Sasuke
